facts.business: MSTC Limited operates as a B2B e-commerce platform facilitating digital auctions, government procurement, and marketing of industrial materials including scrap, minerals, and EPR certificates.

auditor.name: S. Guha & Associates
auditor.emphasis_or_qualification: Emphasis of matter regarding non-availability of balance confirmations for trade receivables, payables, loans, advances, and deposits (Note 38); Key audit matters include recoverability of trade receivables (gross Rs 66,792.80 lakhs, net Rs 22,690.48 lakhs, provision Rs 44,102.32 lakhs), IT systems & controls, and assessment of allowance for bad/doubtful advances and contingent liabilities.

key_risks: Recoverability of trade receivables with significant credit-impaired balances
Dependence on IT systems and controls for financial reporting
Uncertainty in assessment of bad/doubtful advances and contingent liabilities
Non-compliance with board composition requirements (independent directors, woman director) during part of FY 2025-26
Lack of balance confirmations for trade receivables, payables, loans, advances, and deposits
facts.related_party_note: Audit Committee reviews and pre-approves all related party transactions; Joint venture with Mahindra MSTC Recycling Pvt Ltd (1.31% of consolidated net assets)
